metadata.description: Seven independent Spanish official-data skills plugins by Sami Halawa.

plugins.name: licita-espana
plugins.description: Turn a Spanish public tender into a traceable opportunity brief and a clause-by-clause qualification checklist.

plugins.name: ayudas-espana
plugins.description: Find Spanish grant calls and separate potentially relevant funding from closed calls, direct awards and unsupported eligibility claims.

plugins.name: boe-impact
plugins.description: Show what changed in a Spanish legal text, with article-level source evidence and clearly separated practical implications.

plugins.name: borme-intelligence
plugins.description: Find a company’s published registry acts in a specified BORME issue and turn them into a source-linked corporate-events brief.

plugins.name: catastro-pro
plugins.description: Turn a cadastral reference into a clear non-protected property fact sheet without confusing Catastro with title or planning permission.

plugins.name: ine-evidence
plugins.description: Find the correct INE series and answer with its values, definitions, dates and limitations intact.

plugins.name: spain-open-data
plugins.description: Find a reusable Spanish public dataset and explain its publisher, licence, freshness and practical download options.
